modules.title: Sleep
modules.about: Two ways in. Deep Sleep is a soft hypnosis for deeper sleep. Steady Heart for Sleep starts with slow breathing to the sound of wind in a forest, then drifts into sleep suggestions. In both, the voice simply stops and the beats fade out by 90 minutes. You can keep a quiet noise bed going through the night.
modules.honesty: In studies, sleep suggestions helped mainly people who respond easily to hypnosis, and mostly early in the night. Evidence that beats change sleep is mixed. Self-experiment nights help you see what works for you.
cautions: Keep the volume low for sleeping.
If you have ongoing trouble sleeping, talk to a doctor. This is not a treatment for insomnia.

modules.title: Quit Smoking
modules.tagline: Breathe free, one urge at a time
modules.about: One full hypnosis session to build your identity as someone who breathes free, plus short rescue sessions to open the moment a craving hits.
modules.honesty: Hypnosis appears to be about as helpful as other kinds of behavioural support, and may work best as an add-on. Quitting is most likely to succeed when you combine support like this with proven aids such as nicotine replacement or prescription medication, and help from a doctor or quit line.
cautions: Use this alongside proven quitting methods and medical support, never instead of them.
If you are driving when a craving hits, pull over before starting a session.

modules.title: Gratitude
modules.about: A short guided practice: savour one good moment, thank one person, and notice one thing you rely on. Two or three times a week works better than every day.
modules.honesty: Gratitude practices give a real but small lift in mood on average. They are not a treatment for depression or anxiety.
cautions: If nothing good comes to mind, that is okay. Gratitude does not mean pretending things are fine.

modules.title: Inner Coherence
modules.about: Slow breathing at about six breaths a minute, guided by the wind in a forest: it rises as you breathe in and settles as you breathe out, with a brief heart-focused pause.
modules.honesty: Slow paced breathing reliably raises heart rate variability while you do it, and studies show moderate reductions in stress. The breathing is the active part; the beats are a background layer.
cautions: Breathe gently, not deeply. If you feel light-headed, return to normal breathing.
Check with a doctor first if you have a heart or lung condition or are pregnant.

modules.title: Loving Compassion
modules.about: A loving-kindness practice that offers good wishes to someone you love, to yourself, to a stranger, and to everyone.
modules.honesty: Loving-kindness practice has moderate research support for warmer mood and self-compassion. Much of that research compared it with doing nothing, so some of the benefit may be general relaxation.
cautions: Turning kindness toward yourself can bring up sadness or old pain. That is common. You can open your eyes and stop at any time.
